aries.power: With your Sun in Aries, exalted (in the sign where it is strongest) and at full brightness, you lead best by going first and letting others catch up. Your authority comes from visible courage, so claim the hard, unglamorous first move in any project and announce it. Before big decisions, give yourself one hour to cool down, then act without asking permission.
aries.abundance: With your Sun in Aries, money grows when you open new doors rather than wait for invitations. You thrive on launches, pitches and first-mover bets, but you tire of maintenance. Pair every bold start with a simple system (an automatic transfer, a partner who finishes) so the wins you sprint toward actually stick.

taurus.power: With your Sun in Taurus, your power is staying power: you outlast louder people and become the one everyone relies on. Influence builds as you prove you will not be rushed or bullied. Choose one domain to own for years, and practice saying "Let me think about it" so pressure works in your favour.
taurus.abundance: With your Sun in Taurus, you have a natural sense of value and a gift for compounding. Wealth comes through patient accumulation, quality goods and assets you can touch. Raise your prices once a year without apology, and put a fixed slice of every payment into something that grows quietly while you sleep.

gemini.power: With your Sun in Gemini, your authority comes from knowing who to call and how to say it. You influence through words, networks and fast pivots rather than rank. Become the person who translates between teams or ideas, and write down your best lines: a short, sharp message is your most powerful tool.
gemini.abundance: With your Sun in Gemini, opportunity arrives through conversation, side projects and the friend of a friend. Two income streams often suit you better than one. Keep a running list of ideas worth money, test the cheapest one each month, and follow up on every promising chat within forty eight hours.

cancer.power: With your Sun in Cancer, you lead like a guardian: people follow you because they feel safe with you. Your power grows when you protect a team, a family or a mission you care about. Lead from that care openly, and when you feel defensive, ask yourself what you are protecting before you respond.
cancer.abundance: With your Sun in Cancer, you build security instinctively and tend to save, store and nest. Abundance flows through home, food, family businesses and anything that nurtures. Give your savings a name tied to someone you love, and let yourself charge properly for the care you give, rather than offering it free by habit.

leo.power: With your Sun in Leo, its own sign, you are built to be seen and to lead from the heart. Presence is your currency: when you show up fully, rooms warm and people commit. Take the stage on purpose, credit others generously, and remember that confident vulnerability earns more loyalty than polished perfection.
leo.abundance: With your Sun in Leo, abundance follows creative self expression and generosity that feels like play. You attract money by being memorable, so your personal brand matters. Put your name and face on your work, invest in one thing that makes you feel regal, and keep a budget line for gifts so generosity never becomes a leak.

virgo.power: With your Sun in Virgo, your power is competence: you become indispensable by fixing what others overlook. Authority grows when you stop hiding your expertise behind modesty. Document your results with numbers, offer solutions rather than critiques, and let "good enough to ship" be a standard you are proud to hold.
virgo.abundance: With your Sun in Virgo, money comes through skill, systems and useful service. You are excellent at trimming waste, but can undervalue your own labour. Track your hours honestly for one month, then price by the value of the problem you solve, not by how easy it felt to you.

libra.power: With your Sun in Libra, traditionally its fall (a sign where it feels weak), your light shines through others rather than over them. It is a style worth mastering. You lead by diplomacy, taste and alliances, and win by making everyone feel they chose your plan. Practice stating your own preference first, then inviting input, so fairness never erases you.
libra.abundance: With your Sun in Libra, abundance comes through partnership, beauty and well negotiated deals. You are a natural broker and do best with a collaborator who balances you. Never accept the first offer: ask "Is there flexibility here?" with a smile, and get every agreement in writing, however friendly it feels.

scorpio.power: With your Sun in Scorpio, you hold power quietly and use it with precision. People sense your intensity before you speak, and you excel in crises, research and anything requiring nerve. Keep your strategy private until it is ready, and choose your battles: one decisive move beats ten small skirmishes.
scorpio.abundance: With your Sun in Scorpio, wealth often comes through shared resources: investments, partnerships, inheritances or other people's money handled well. You are skilled at seeing hidden value. Read every contract fully, learn how debt and equity actually work, and redirect money you lose to resentment toward one long term holding.

sagittarius.power: With your Sun in Sagittarius, you lead by vision and enthusiasm, selling a future people want to live in. Your honesty is a strength when it is tied to a big why. Teach, publish or speak about what you believe, and pair every grand promise with one concrete next step so your credibility keeps pace with your optimism.
sagittarius.abundance: With your Sun in Sagittarius, luck tends to find you when you widen your range: travel, education, foreign markets, publishing. 5.libra: Libra on your 5th house (romance and play) makes romance elegant and charming. You love courtship, beauty and harmony; plan art openings, dinners in beautiful places, and flirt with compliments that feel sincere. Venus rules this sign (it is the sign's guiding planet), so beauty truly is your love language. Dress for yourself and let the date feel like an occasion.
5.scorpio: Scorpio on your 5th house (romance and play) makes romance intense and all-or-nothing. Your flirting is magnetic and layered; let mystery draw people in, and save your deepest play for those who earn your trust. Hold a little back on early dates, so desire has time to build.
5.sagittarius: Sagittarius on your 5th house (romance and play) makes romance adventurous and light-hearted. You love laughter and discovery; plan trips, try new cultures and keep flirting honest and full of humour. Say yes to the unexpected invitation; that is often where your next romance begins, far from your usual routine.
5.capricorn: Capricorn on your 5th house (romance and play) makes romance slow, sincere and slightly reserved. You flirt by showing competence and reliability; plan quality dates, and give yourself permission to play without needing a purpose. Saturn rules here (it is the sign's guiding planet), so love can bloom later in life and gets better with age.
5.aquarius: Aquarius on your 5th house (romance and play) makes romance quirky and friendly. You fall for originality; try unusual dates, flirt through ideas and shared causes, and let friendship become romance naturally. Group outings and festivals often spark your romances, so keep saying yes to the crowd.
5.pisces: Pisces on your 5th house (romance and play) makes romance dreamy and imaginative. You flirt through poetry, music and empathy. Plan dates by the water or at a film, and keep one foot on the ground about who someone really is.

sun.1: Your identity is on display: people notice you before you speak, which is raw power. Lead from presence, and choose clothes and posture that match the person you are becoming.
sun.2: You find yourself through earning and owning; self-worth and net worth are linked. Build income from your core talent, and keep confidence independent of your bank balance.
sun.3: You shine through words, ideas and local connections. Write, teach or speak regularly; your influence grows one conversation and one post at a time.
sun.4: Your power is rooted in home and family; you shine most in private. Build a base that recharges you, and consider work from home or real estate as a path to abundance.
sun.5: You are made for romance, creativity and play; joy is your power source. Flirt openly, create something every week, and let pleasure guide your choices.
sun.6: You shine through excellent work and healthy routines. Become the indispensable expert, track your wins, and protect your energy with daily habits that keep you strong.
sun.7: You come alive in partnership; others help you see yourself. Choose collaborators and lovers who match your light, and keep your own goals visible within the pair.
sun.8: Your core self grows through intimacy, crisis and shared resources. Embrace depth in love and sex, and learn to manage investments or other people's money with skill.
sun.9: You find purpose through travel, study and belief. Teach what you know, publish, or work across borders; your vision is your authority.
sun.10: You are built for a public career and visible achievement. Set ambitious goals, accept leadership roles, and let your reputation become your legacy.
sun.11: You shine in groups, networks and causes. Build a powerful circle of friends and allies; your biggest opportunities arrive through who you know.
sun.12: Your power works behind the scenes, through intuition, solitude or service. Protect quiet time, and trust that private work done well eventually becomes public strength.

moon.1: Your feelings show on your face, making you magnetic and approachable. Use that warmth to connect, and pause before reacting so moods do not lead your decisions.
moon.2: Emotional security is tied to money and comfort. Build savings that soothe you, and notice when you spend to calm a feeling rather than to meet a need.
moon.3: You process feelings by talking and writing. Journal daily, and in love, send the message you are thinking; emotional honesty in words draws people close.
moon.4: The Moon is at home here: family and a cosy base are everything to you. Invest in your home, and let loved ones in; nurturing is where your love flows best.
moon.5: You need fun, romance and creative play to feel well. Flirt freely, date with joy, and make space for playful pleasure without guilt.
moon.6: Your mood and body are tightly linked. Healthy routines make you emotionally steady; stick to sleep and meals, and choose work that feels meaningful day to day.
moon.7: You need partnership to feel emotionally safe. Choose partners who nurture you back, and voice your needs clearly rather than hoping they are guessed.
moon.8: Your emotions run deep and want total merging. Intimacy with trust is your healing ground; talk about fears openly and share vulnerable truths with one safe person.
moon.9: You feel most alive when exploring or learning. Plan trips and courses that nourish you, and seek a partner who shares your hunger for meaning.
moon.10: Your feelings are tied to your public role; the public may feel close to you. Choose a career that cares for people, and protect privacy to keep your heart steady.
moon.11: Friendships and community feed your heart. Gather a chosen family, and let networking feel like belonging; opportunities come through those who care about you.
moon.12: Your emotions are private and intuitive. Make time for solitude, dreams and reflection, and let one trusted partner see the tender, hidden parts of you.

venus.1: You radiate charm and beauty; attraction comes easily. Use it consciously in love and business, and invest in style that expresses who you truly are.
venus.2: Venus is at home here: money and pleasure flow toward you. Earn through beauty, design or relationships, and enjoy what you own without overspending on it.
venus.3: Your charm lives in words. Flirt through messages and conversation, write sweet notes, and use diplomatic language to win negotiations.
venus.4: Love blooms at home; you want a beautiful, peaceful nest. Host dinners, decorate with care, and choose a partner who values domestic harmony.
venus.5: Romance and play are your natural gifts. Plan delightful dates, create art, and let yourself be adored; this spot in your chart is classic for joyful love affairs.
venus.6: You show love through service and find harmony at work. Beautify your workspace, build kind relationships with colleagues, and care for your body with pleasure, not punishment.
venus.7: Venus loves this house: partnerships and marriage are your path to happiness. Choose partners with care, invest in shared beauty, and negotiate business deals with grace.
venus.8: Love for you is deep, sensual and transformative. Your intimate life is rich; share money and trust carefully, and let intimacy be a space of true devotion.
venus.9: You fall for people from other cultures or with big ideas. Love grows on journeys and through shared learning; plan a trip or a course together.
venus.10: Charm is your career asset; you are liked in public. Work in beauty, art or diplomacy, and use your grace to win allies and promotions.
venus.11: Love and luck come through friends and networks. Your social circle is your dating pool and business network; host gatherings and stay generous with introductions.
venus.12: Your love is private, compassionate and sometimes secret. Value quiet intimacy, protect yourself from one-sided devotion, and let art or retreat restore you.

mars.1: You come across as bold, energetic and physically confident. Use that drive to lead, and channel restlessness into sport so it does not become impatience with others.
mars.2: You fight for your money and earn through effort. Go after income aggressively, but avoid impulse spending; set financial goals you can chase like a race.
mars.3: Your words are sharp and persuasive. Use them to sell and debate, and soften your tone in love; a playful challenge flirts better than an argument.
mars.4: Your drive is tied to home and family; you may fight to protect your base. Use energy for renovation or building property, and handle family tension directly but kindly.
mars.5: You chase pleasure, romance and creativity with fire. Your sexual confidence is high; pursue what excites you, and keep competition playful rather than possessive.
mars.6: You work hard and need physical activity. Channel energy into a strong daily routine and exercise; avoid burnout by taking regular breaks.
mars.7: You attract dynamic, assertive partners and may clash with them. Use conflict to grow together, and fight fair with clear rules for disagreement.
mars.8: Desire runs deep and intense here; sexual chemistry is a strong force for you. Explore it with trust, and be strategic with shared money and investments.
mars.9: You fight for your beliefs and chase adventure. Travel, compete in debates or study fiercely; let conviction drive you without preaching.
mars.10: You are built to pursue a high-profile career with energy. Set bold targets, take charge in public, and handle authority figures with strategic courage.
mars.11: You act through groups and causes. Lead teams, organise movements, and use your energy to rally allies toward shared goals.
mars.12: Your drive works in private and your desire can be hidden. Name what you want to yourself first, work behind the scenes, and use exercise or meditation to release pent-up energy.

jupiter.1: You radiate optimism and generosity, attracting luck through your presence. Say yes to opportunities, but avoid overpromising; your confidence is your biggest asset.
jupiter.2: A classic spot in your chart for money: income grows when you invest in your talents. Spend on growth, keep a long-range savings plan and trust abundance without being careless.
jupiter.3: Luck comes through communication, learning and local contacts. Write, teach or network actively; one good conversation can open a lucrative door.
jupiter.4: Abundance grows through home, family and property. Invest in real estate or a generous home base, and let family support become a resource.
jupiter.5: Romance, creativity and play bring luck. Date with joy, create boldly, and consider creative ventures or investments in entertainment.
jupiter.6: Opportunity comes through daily work and service. Improve systems, care for your health, and you will grow steadily within your job or business.
jupiter.7: Partners bring luck and expansion. Choose generous, growth-minded partners in love and business; collaboration multiplies your abundance.
jupiter.8: Luck flows through shared resources and deep intimacy. Investments, inheritance or partners' money can grow; in love, expansive trust deepens desire.
jupiter.9: Jupiter is at home here: travel, study and belief bring luck. Teach, publish or go abroad, and let your vision guide big decisions.
jupiter.10: Career luck and public recognition come easily. Aim high, accept leadership, and use your reputation to open doors for others too.
jupiter.11: Friends and networks are your lucky charm. Build community, say yes to invitations, and let collaboration bring opportunities.
jupiter.12: Hidden help and intuition protect you. Trust quiet guidance, give generously in private, and let retreat or spiritual practice renew your abundance.

saturn.1: You may seem serious or reserved, but you build authority over time. Practise confident presence, and let maturity become your leadership edge.
saturn.2: Money comes slowly but solidly. Build financial discipline, save consistently, and work on worth beliefs; patience brings real security.
saturn.3: You speak carefully and can doubt your mind. Train your voice through study and practice; your words gain weight and authority over time.
saturn.4: Home and family may feel heavy or demanding. Build your own stable base, set boundaries with relatives, and let your roots become strength.
saturn.5: Play and romance can feel risky, so you may hold back. Give yourself permission to enjoy; slow-building love affairs and disciplined creativity reward you.
saturn.6: You are a dedicated worker who must watch for overwork. Build sustainable routines, set clear limits, and treat health as long-term investment.
saturn.7: Partnership is serious for you, often with a mature or older partner. Choose commitments carefully, and build trust through shared responsibility and honest contracts.
saturn.8: Intimacy requires trust and time. Face fears around vulnerability with a patient partner, and manage shared finances carefully to build long-term security.
saturn.9: Beliefs and learning demand rigour. Study deeply, earn credentials, and let your hard-won wisdom become a source of authority.
saturn.10: Saturn is strong here: ambition and long-term career success are your path. Climb steadily, take responsibility, and your reputation will endure.
saturn.11: Friendships are fewer but loyal. Invest in a solid network, take a structured role in groups, and long-term alliances bring opportunity.
saturn.12: Hidden fears or solitude shape you. Use reflection, therapy or meditation to transform them; inner discipline brings quiet strength.

sun.fusion: Your solar return (the Sun back where it was when you were born, around your birthday): the personal year resets and your vitality peaks. Set one bold intention for your power this week, write it down, and say it aloud to someone who will hold you to it.
sun.flow: Confidence comes easily this week and people read you as capable. Ask for the visible role, the meeting or the raise conversation now, while your presence persuades without effort.
sun.tension: Your will meets friction this week and your ego bruises easily. Pick one fight worth having, let the rest go, and pour the restless heat into a hard workout or a finished task.

moon.fusion: Head and heart line up today, so what you want feels unusually clear. Tell your partner or someone you fancy one real feeling; warmth offered now is received as sincere.
moon.flow: An easy, nourishing few days for home and closeness. Cook for someone, host a small supper or simply rest, because the emotional security you build now fuels tomorrow's confidence.
moon.tension: What you want and what you need pull apart this week, often as touchiness at home. Name the need plainly ("I need a quiet evening") before it leaks out as a sulk.

venus.fusion: Your charm is switched on today: you look good, sound good and attract easily. Book the date, wear the thing you love, and let compliments land without deflecting them.
venus.flow: Pleasure and goodwill flow this week. Ask a favour, smooth over a money conversation, or plan a slow, sensual evening with someone you desire. People want to say yes to you.
venus.tension: You crave approval or treats this week, which can tip into overspending or people pleasing. Enjoy one indulgence on purpose, and before agreeing to anyone, check that you truly want it.

mars.fusion: Energy, drive and libido surge this week. Start the hard thing, train hard, and let desire be direct: say what you want in bed instead of waiting to be guessed.
mars.flow: Courage arrives without strain this week. Make the pitch, send the cold email or initiate with your lover; action taken now meets little resistance and builds real momentum.
mars.tension: Temper and impatience run hot this week, so collisions with bosses or partners are likely. Burn the excess off physically first, then make your point in one calm sentence.

jupiter.fusion: Optimism and generosity peak, and luck follows visibility this week. Pitch big, apply, network or teach what you know, but read the fine print before you sign anything.
jupiter.flow: A lucky, expansive few days in which mentors and opportunities respond well. Ask someone senior for advice or an introduction, and accept the invitation that stretches you.
jupiter.tension: Overconfidence is the trap this week: promising, spending or eating too much. Keep the big vision, but halve the budget and double the deadline before you commit.

asc.fusion: All eyes turn to you this week, and your face and body broadcast vitality. Refresh your look, show up in person, and introduce yourself to the people you want to remember you.
asc.flow: You come across as relaxed and radiant this week. Let people see you: post the photo, take the call on camera, and let a flirtation grow out of easy friendliness.
asc.tension: Someone challenges how you present yourself this week, or a partner wants more of your attention. Listen before defending, then adjust one thing about your approach rather than everything.

mc.fusion: Your public stock is high this week and people in charge notice you. Share a result, claim credit for your work, and make the career request you have been rehearsing.
mc.flow: Work and private life cooperate this week, so effort is seen and rewarded. Polish your portfolio or profile, and have the career chat over coffee rather than in a formal review.
mc.tension: Home demands clash with work ambitions this week, or a boss tests your nerve. Protect one evening for family and one block for deep work, and decline the rest.

sun.fusion: Your mind and voice sharpen this week. Write the proposal or send the message that states plainly who you are and what you want; clear words carry authority now.
sun.flow: Conversations go your way this week and people follow your logic. Negotiate terms, sort simple paperwork, and talk money with the figures in front of you.
sun.tension: Overthinking and crossed wires are likely this week, especially if you argue to win. Reread emails before sending, and ask "What did you hear me say?" when things heat up.

moon.fusion: Feelings want words today. Journal for ten minutes, then tell someone you love one honest thing you have been holding back. It will land as intimacy, not drama.
moon.flow: Warm, easy talk today, good for heart to hearts, family calls or pillow talk that turns playful. Ask your partner what they need this week, then really listen.
moon.tension: Mood colours logic today, so small remarks feel loaded. Wait an hour before replying to anything that stings, and separate the facts from the feeling before you speak.

venus.fusion: Sweet words come easily this week. Send the flirty text, write a love note, or ask for a better price with charm. Your tone is your currency right now.
venus.flow: Diplomacy is effortless this week. Settle a disagreement, negotiate a fair fee, or talk openly with your partner about pleasure and what you each enjoy.
venus.tension: You may say what pleases rather than what is true this week. Stay kind but specific, especially in money talks and when someone asks what you really want in bed.

mars.fusion: Your words have edge and speed this week. Use them to argue a case, close a deal or talk boldly about desire, and pause a beat before replying in anger.
mars.flow: Quick, decisive thinking this week: solve the problem, make the call, send the bold offer. Direct, teasing banter also turns up the chemistry with someone you want.
mars.tension: Sharp tongues and rushed decisions this week. Count to ten before hitting send, drive with care, and if you must debate, attack the idea and never the person.

jupiter.fusion: Big ideas and good news arrive this week. Pitch the vision, sign up for the course, or talk to an investor or advisor, then verify every detail twice.
jupiter.flow: Your words carry weight and goodwill this week. Ideal for teaching, selling or asking a mentor for a referral; generous, confident talk opens doors to money.
jupiter.tension: Thinking big makes you miss details this week, or promise more than you can deliver. Write the plan down, cut it by a third, and read every clause before signing.

asc.fusion: You come across as bright and articulate this week. Speak up in meetings, record the video, or open a conversation with someone you find attractive.
asc.flow: Quick wit makes you good company this week. Network lightly, send a few check in messages, and let playful banter turn into actual plans.
asc.tension: Nervous energy makes you misread others, or be misread, this week. Slow your speech, breathe before presenting, and ask partners what they meant instead of assuming.

mc.fusion: Career conversations and public communication are favoured this week. Email the decision maker, publish the post, or ask directly what it takes to be promoted.
mc.flow: Plans and paperwork for your career move smoothly this week. Update your CV, draft the pitch, and book the meeting that moves you up a rung.
mc.tension: Mixed messages at work, or between work and home, this week. Put every agreement in writing and confirm deadlines rather than trusting anyone's memory, including yours.

sun.fusion: You are magnetic this week and people want to be near you. Say yes to dates and invitations, treat yourself, and ask for something you want while goodwill is high.
sun.flow: A sweet, easy week for love and money. Plan a romantic evening, buy something beautiful that you will actually use, and let affection be given freely rather than earned.
sun.tension: A craving to be adored can cloud judgement this week. Enjoy the attention, but do not buy approval with money or overgiving, and check every price tag twice.

moon.fusion: Tenderness and comfort peak today. Make your home lovely, cuddle up, cook something indulgent, and tell someone exactly how much they mean to you.
moon.flow: Emotional and sensual ease today. Perfect for a long bath, unhurried lovemaking, or mending things with family over a shared meal.
moon.tension: Comfort seeking can turn into emotional spending or eating this week. Name the feeling first, then choose a soothing that will not cost you tomorrow.

venus.fusion: Your Venus return: you are at your most attractive and receptive, and a fresh yearly cycle in love and money begins. Update your style, set a pleasure intention, and review your budget.
venus.flow: Your taste, your heart and your money sense agree this week. Shop for quality, say yes to a flirtation, and spend an hour on something purely for beauty.
venus.tension: What you value and what you crave disagree this week. Sleep on impulse purchases, and ask honestly whether a relationship pattern still gives you what you want.

mars.fusion: Peak chemistry: affection and desire fuse this week. Dress to seduce, flirt boldly, and initiate; erotic confidence is your natural state right now.
mars.flow: Easy sensual chemistry this week. Plan intimacy with plenty of time for teasing and play, and spend the same spark on making a deal or a beautiful thing.
mars.tension: Desire runs hot but out of sync this week, so teasing can tip into frustration. Talk about what turns you on, and use the friction as heat rather than a fight.

jupiter.fusion: A classic lucky week for love, pleasure and money. Ask for the raise, accept the invitation, and celebrate, while keeping the celebration within budget.
jupiter.flow: Generosity comes back to you this week. Host, give a thoughtful gift or make an introduction, and expect kindness in return. A fine time to sell or to open your heart.
jupiter.tension: Too much of a good thing this week: food, shopping or romance in excess. Choose one treat, cap the spend, and make only promises you can afford to keep.

asc.fusion: You look and feel gorgeous this week. Get the haircut, book the photos, and walk into rooms where you can be seen; attraction is effortless.
asc.flow: Charm is your best strategy this week. A smile and a sincere compliment open more doors than argument, in negotiations and on dates alike.
asc.tension: A partner wants more warmth than you are giving this week, or you feel self conscious. Make one sincere gesture toward them, and be gentle with yourself in the mirror.

mc.fusion: Your reputation gets a glow this week. Network, show creative work, or ask for better pay with grace; being liked is a real career asset right now.
mc.flow: Pleasant connections at work this week. Collaborate, make your workspace beautiful, or invite someone influential for coffee and simply be good company.
mc.tension: Work and love compete for your time this week, or office warmth gets misread. Keep flirting off the clock and guard date night from late meetings.

sun.fusion: A burst of drive and libido this week. Launch the bold project, train hard and take the lead in love, aiming the fire at one target rather than spraying it.
sun.flow: Stamina and nerve are easy to find this week. Tackle the task you have dodged, ask for what you are owed, and let physical attraction lead somewhere.
sun.tension: Ego clashes are likely this week, especially with people who outrank you. Move your body daily, choose battles carefully, and do not burn bridges for a moment's satisfaction.

moon.fusion: Emotions run fast and fiery today. Say the angry thing cleanly or use it to clear clutter; heat at home can turn passionate if you let tenderness in.
moon.flow: Your gut instincts are reliable and ready to act today. Defend someone you love, follow a hunch, or turn a cosy evening into something more heated.
moon.tension: Irritability at home runs high this week. Take space before snapping, and burn off adrenaline with exercise before any hard conversation with family or a partner.

venus.fusion: Sexual chemistry spikes this week and attraction is immediate. Make the first move, be clear about your desire, and keep consent explicit and enthusiastic.
venus.flow: Desire and affection cooperate this week, ideal for seduction and passionate reconnection. Plan a night where you take turns leading.
venus.tension: Lust pulls against comfort this week, sparking tension with lovers or impulsive spending. Flirty friction is fine; turn any argument into a conversation about what you each want.

mars.fusion: Your Mars return opens a new two year cycle of drive. Choose one goal to fight for, start training toward it, and reclaim your sexual confidence on your own terms.
mars.flow: Your energy runs clean and efficient this week. Push the project forward, compete, and ask plainly for what you want at work and in bed.
mars.tension: Blocked energy makes you feel pushed or pushy this week. Redirect it into physical effort and one strategic move instead of a confrontation you will regret.

jupiter.fusion: Bold action is rewarded this week. Launch, sell or take a calculated risk; your enthusiasm is contagious, but never bet more than you can afford to lose.
jupiter.flow: Energy meets luck this week, perfect for sport, sales and new ventures. Go after the big client, or ask out the person you thought was out of your league.
jupiter.tension: Overreach is the risk this week: rash spending, overtraining or a fight over principle. Keep the ambition, but write a plan before you leap.

asc.fusion: You radiate energy and sex appeal this week, though you may come on strong. Lead, exercise and flirt boldly, and slow down physically to avoid cuts and bumps.
asc.flow: You come across as decisive and attractive this week. Use it to lead a team, start a fitness plan, or make a confident first move.
asc.tension: Others push back or a partner picks a fight this week. Do not take the bait: state your boundary calmly, then let the heat out in a workout.

mc.fusion: Career ambition surges this week. Go for the promotion, push a stalled project over the line, or confront a workplace problem head on.
mc.flow: Hard work gets noticed this week. Take the initiative, volunteer to lead, and finish what others left half done.
mc.tension: Clashes with bosses, or between job and home, this week. Fight only for what matters, keep a written record, and keep your temper professional.

sun.fusion: A once in twelve years season of growth and recognition. Over these weeks, say yes to whatever enlarges your life: a bigger role, travel, study or a public stage.
sun.flow: Doors open gently over these weeks and helpers appear. Pursue the promotion or the investment with steady effort, because this luck rewards people already moving.
sun.tension: Growth arrives with excess over these weeks: overcommitment, inflated plans, a touch of arrogance. Commit only to what you can deliver, and let the rest go gracefully.

moon.fusion: A season of emotional abundance in which family, home and comfort expand. Consider the move or the renovation, and let yourself be generously cared for.
moon.flow: Contentment grows at home over these weeks. Host, nurture, and invest in whatever makes you feel safe; love becomes easier to receive.
moon.tension: Emotional overindulgence tempts you over these weeks: too much comfort food, giving or home spending. Nourish yourself fully, but set a ceiling and keep to it.

venus.fusion: One of the luckiest love and money periods of your cycle. Over these weeks, socialise widely, say yes to romance, and ask boldly for the fee you deserve.
venus.flow: A sweet season for love, art and income. Grow your creative work, deepen a relationship, or raise your rates; generosity here attracts more of the same.
venus.tension: Love and spending both inflate over these weeks. Enjoy the pleasure, watch the credit card, and get to know a new lover before you crown them as the one.

mars.fusion: Courage and appetite expand over these weeks. Launch the venture, take on the physical challenge, and let your sexual hunger grow freely and joyfully.
mars.flow: Drive and good fortune work together over these weeks. Ideal for entrepreneurship, competition and initiating romance; act first and refine later.
mars.tension: Overconfidence invites rash moves over these weeks. Aim high, but plan the logistics, and risk only money and energy you can genuinely spare.

jupiter.fusion: Your Jupiter return starts a new twelve year cycle of growth. Over these weeks, write a big long term vision and enrol in whatever expands you: study, travel or investment.
jupiter.flow: Faith and opportunity are in harmony over these weeks. Keep building on what already works; small, generous expansions compound into real abundance.
jupiter.tension: A checkpoint in your twelve year growth cycle reveals what you have outgrown. Over these weeks, update your beliefs and plans, and drop the ones that no longer fit.

asc.fusion: A season of personal expansion: you feel and look more confident. Over these weeks, step into bigger rooms, meet new people, and expect generous partnerships.
asc.flow: Goodwill follows you over these weeks. Use your optimism to attract allies, collaborators and lovers, because people want to bet on you now.
asc.tension: You may be a bit too much over these weeks, in size, spending or promises. Keep your generosity genuine and your commitments to partners realistic.

mc.fusion: Career peak potential: recognition, promotion or a major offer is likely over these weeks. Apply, pitch, and say yes to every chance to be seen.
mc.flow: Professional growth comes smoothly over these weeks. Widen your network, teach or publish, and let your reputation grow through generous service.
mc.tension: Career ambitions balloon over these weeks, possibly at home's expense. Choose growth that fits the life you want, and avoid promising bosses the moon.

sun.fusion: A serious season that tests your identity and ambition. Over these weeks, choose one long term goal, commit to it with discipline, and drop whatever is only ego.
sun.flow: Steady effort pays off over these weeks. Build structure, earn respect, and make the sober commitment or investment you have been weighing.
sun.tension: Pressure and delays test your resolve over these weeks. Sleep well, prune commitments and work patiently; this is exactly where real authority is earned.

moon.fusion: Emotional weight or new duties at home over these weeks. Build steady routines, lean on people you trust, and let love show itself in practical care.
moon.flow: Emotional maturity and stability grow over these weeks. A good time to set family boundaries, budget for the home, or commit steadily to someone.
moon.tension: You may feel lonely or burdened over these weeks. Ask for help out loud, simplify home life, and book self care like a meeting you cannot cancel.

venus.fusion: Love and money get serious over these weeks, so relationships are tested or made official. Commit or clarify, budget carefully, and choose quality over quantity.
venus.flow: Durable love and financial prudence go together over these weeks. Sign the shared lease, start a savings habit, or invest in things that last.
venus.tension: Love feels cool or money feels tight over these weeks. Do not panic: tighten the budget, have the honest relationship talk, and rebuild affection deliberately.

mars.fusion: Drive meets discipline over these weeks: frustration if you rush, mastery if you train. Commit to a strict regimen, and slow sex down to build stamina and trust.
mars.flow: Controlled, strategic effort pays off over these weeks. Excellent for hard projects, fitness goals and patient, skilful lovemaking.
mars.tension: Blocked energy and friction with authority build over these weeks. Work smarter rather than harder, guard against injury, and turn anger into a structured plan.

jupiter.fusion: Growth meets reality over these weeks, so expansion must stand on solid ground. Consolidate gains, pay down debt, and make investments for the long haul.
jupiter.flow: Wise, grounded growth over these weeks. Good for long term financial planning, formal mentorships, and building a business one brick at a time.
jupiter.tension: Optimism hits limits over these weeks. Revise plans realistically and cut waste, but do not abandon the dream; resize it so it can actually be built.

asc.fusion: A sober season: you may feel tired or older, and others notice your gravity. Over these weeks, refine your health, habits and image for the long haul.
asc.flow: You come across as reliable and authoritative over these weeks. Spend that credibility on a career move or a serious relationship conversation.
asc.tension: Partnerships and self image are under pressure over these weeks. Define your boundaries, care for your body, and keep only the commitments that are real.

mc.fusion: Career harvest: over these weeks you reap what you have sown professionally. Claim the authority you have earned, or restructure if the path no longer fits.
mc.flow: Steady career progress over these weeks. Take on responsibility, ask for a title that matches your real role, and build reputation through reliability.
mc.tension: Career pressure or family duty weighs on you over these weeks. Prioritise, delegate and lay foundations; slow progress is still progress.

sun.fusion: A season of awakening in which you outgrow old identities. Experiment boldly with your work and image, and let your unusual edge become the source of your power.
sun.flow: Liberating change comes easily in this chapter of life. Try the side venture, the new technology or the unconventional idea; curiosity is your best career strategy now.
sun.tension: Sudden shake ups in this chapter push you to change direction. Keep a cash cushion, stay flexible, and choose freedom deliberately rather than in a burst of rebellion.

moon.fusion: A long season of emotional restlessness: home, family or living arrangements may change suddenly. Make room for independence in your relationships, and let new feelings surprise you.
moon.flow: Emotional freedom grows gently in this chapter. Redesign how you live and love, perhaps with new routines or a new city, and invite friends into your inner circle.
moon.tension: Unsettled moods and domestic surprises mark this season. Build small anchoring rituals, and give your partner clear notice before you rearrange your shared life.

venus.fusion: Love and money are electrified in this chapter: sudden attractions, new tastes, unusual income. Experiment with style and sensual exploration, but wait before merging finances.
venus.flow: Exciting, freeing connections arrive in this season. Say yes to unconventional dates, creative collaborations, and fresh streams of income from things you enjoy.
venus.tension: Restlessness in love and erratic finances mark this chapter. Talk openly with partners about space and novelty, and keep a buffer for sudden expenses.

mars.fusion: A season of electric drive: impulses are sudden and bold. Channel them into innovation and new erotic adventures, and take extra care with speed, tools and tempers.
mars.flow: Inventive energy and erotic curiosity run high in this chapter. Start the unusual venture, try a new sport, or explore fresh fantasies with a willing partner.
mars.tension: Rebellion and abrupt action define this season. Pause before quitting, crashing or blowing up a relationship, and direct the jolt into one brave, planned change.

jupiter.fusion: Unexpected opportunities and lucky breaks mark this season. Stay alert, say yes to the unusual offer, and keep investments diversified as fortune changes quickly.
jupiter.flow: Innovative growth flows easily in this chapter. Take a course in a new field, back an odd idea with a small stake, and let curiosity lead you to unexpected income.
jupiter.tension: Wild swings between opportunity and disruption mark this season. Skip get rich quick schemes, keep a reserve fund, and say yes only to offers you have tested on paper.

asc.fusion: You reinvent yourself in this chapter: new look, new energy, new freedom. Let people meet the person you are becoming, and expect partnerships to change with you.
asc.flow: You come across as fresh and original in this season. Lean into an unconventional image that wins attention, collaborators and intriguing lovers.
asc.tension: Relationships destabilise in this chapter as you crave space. Name your need for independence honestly, rather than letting it explode or sneak out.

mc.fusion: A career revolution: this season brings sudden change in vocation or public role. Pivot toward work that expresses your uniqueness, and update your skills fast.
mc.flow: Progressive career moves come easily in this chapter. Embrace freelance, tech or innovative roles, and let your reputation grow as a forward thinker.
mc.tension: Career disruption or tension between freedom and duty in this season. Build skills that travel, keep a side income, and leave on your terms if you must leave.

sun.fusion: A dreamy, dissolving season: old ambitions blur and spiritual or creative callings rise. Protect your energy, verify facts and promises, and let art or service become a source of power.
sun.flow: Inspiration and compassion flow through this chapter. Create, heal or serve; intuition guides career choices, as long as you still keep your calendar.
sun.tension: Confusion about direction or a slow drain of energy marks this season. Sleep more, check every contract twice, and steer clear of escapism and flattering schemes.

moon.fusion: Heightened sensitivity and empathy colour this season. Make home a sanctuary, take care with boundaries, and seek intimacy that is soulful rather than merely soothing.
moon.flow: Emotional intuition and tenderness run deep in this chapter. Meditate, make music, and let love grow through gentle, imaginative closeness.
moon.tension: Emotional fog or family confusion marks this season. Keep honest boundaries, limit alcohol and other escapes, and ask direct questions instead of guessing.

venus.fusion: Romance becomes idealised and enchanting in this chapter. Enjoy soulmate feelings and artistic pleasure, but keep your eyes open and your bank account separate for now.
venus.flow: Spiritual love, beauty and compassion flow in this season. Write, paint or dance, and deepen intimacy through tenderness, fantasy and imagination.
venus.tension: Disillusion in love or money confusion marks this chapter. Watch for rescuing fantasies and vague deals; fall for character, not illusion.

mars.fusion: Drive becomes diffuse and idealistic in this season. Fight for a cause, explore sensual fantasy with a trusted partner, and protect your stamina with rest.
mars.flow: Inspired action and erotic imagination mingle in this chapter. Act on intuition, move to music, and let sensual play be slow and dreamy.
mars.tension: Low energy, passive resistance or confused desire mark this season. Clarify what you really want, avoid deceptive dealings, and build gentle routines.

jupiter.fusion: A season of faith, generosity and spiritual expansion. Give wisely, follow inspiration, and keep at least one practical anchor for your finances.
jupiter.flow: Compassion and imagination open doors in this chapter. Turn creative, charitable or healing work into a paid offer, and price it fairly rather than giving it all away.
jupiter.tension: Overoptimism and wishful thinking threaten your finances in this season. Do due diligence, avoid speculative bets, and test promises before you believe them.

asc.fusion: Your image softens and becomes mysterious in this chapter. Embrace glamour and empathy, guard against being projected on, and look after your body's sensitivity.
asc.flow: You come across as gentle and magnetic in this season. Use artistic presentation and kindness to draw in allies and dreamy romance.
asc.tension: Confusion in partnerships or about who you are marks this chapter. Ask for clarity, honour your own needs, and avoid self sacrifice that erases you.

mc.fusion: Career goals dissolve and transform in this season, opening a calling in art, healing or service. Keep earning while you explore, and make your vision tangible.
mc.flow: Inspired, meaningful work comes more easily in this chapter. Lean into creative, spiritual or humanitarian roles that let your reputation grow through compassion.
mc.tension: Fogginess about career direction or reputation marks this season. Keep things transparent, check facts, and focus on small, practical steps forward.

sun.fusion: A profound season of transformation: old selves die and a more powerful you emerges. Face power struggles honestly, and invest your intensity in purposeful work.
sun.flow: Deep, steady empowerment runs through this chapter. Take the lead in transformative projects, invest strategically, and let intensity fuel your ambition.
sun.tension: Power struggles and crises push deep change in this season. Release control where you can, and refuse to be manipulated or to manipulate; this rebirth is earned.

moon.fusion: Emotional intensity and family transformation mark this chapter. Heal old wounds through therapy or deep conversation, and allow intimacy that truly transforms.
moon.flow: Emotional depth and healing come more easily in this season. Release old patterns, deepen trust with a partner, and let vulnerability become strength.
moon.tension: Emotional upheaval and buried feelings rise in this chapter. Face them, work with a skilled guide if needed, and avoid control games at home.

venus.fusion: Love becomes obsessive, transformative and magnetic in this season. Explore erotic depth and intimacy, and guard against jealousy or financial entanglement.
venus.flow: Deep, powerful bonds and wise financial investments flow in this chapter. Commit to intimacy that changes you, and invest in assets with long term value.
venus.tension: Jealousy, power plays in love, or money crises mark this season. Name your fears, release possessiveness, and restructure shared finances clearly.

mars.fusion: A volcanic season of drive, desire and ambition. Channel intensity into goals and passionate sex, and avoid ruthless tactics that backfire.
mars.flow: Powerful, sustained energy fuels this chapter. Take on the huge project, start strength training, and deepen sexual intimacy by sharing one desire you have kept private.
mars.tension: Power struggles and suppressed anger erupt in this season. Pursue goals strategically, avoid dangerous confrontations, and transform rage into resolve.

jupiter.fusion: A season of major growth and wealth building. Think big, put money and effort into a few strategic bets, and seek real influence while keeping your ethics in plain view.
jupiter.flow: Opportunities for deep, lasting abundance flow through this chapter. Research before you invest, then commit for the long term, and cultivate one alliance with someone who holds real influence.
jupiter.tension: Ambition and appetite for more may tempt you in this season. Before any big deal, ask "Would I be proud if this were public?" and grow by integrity rather than force.

asc.fusion: A personal metamorphosis: your presence becomes intense and magnetic in this chapter. Embrace your power, and transform your body, image and relationships consciously.
asc.flow: Your presence gains depth and authority in this season. Use it to influence others, attract intense connections, and lead with quiet strength.
asc.tension: Relationships become power struggles in this chapter. Examine control patterns, set firm boundaries, and allow partnerships to transform or end.

mc.fusion: A career transformation: power, authority and reputation change dramatically in this season. Pursue roles with real influence, and handle power ethically.
mc.flow: Career empowerment builds steadily in this chapter. Seek strategic positions, research deeply, and build alliances with influential people.
mc.tension: Power struggles with authority or a career crisis mark this season. Stay ethical, document everything, and let what is broken be rebuilt stronger.

mercury.power: Mercury retrograde (when Mercury seems to move backwards in the sky) slows plans and contracts for about three weeks. Revisit, revise and renegotiate rather than launching, and reconnect with old contacts who can open doors.
mercury.abundance: Money admin needs care now: double check invoices, subscriptions and payments. A great window to chase unpaid invoices or revisit an old business idea.
mercury.love: Old flames and unresolved conversations resurface. Say what was left unsaid, listen before replying, and clarify plans so misunderstandings do not spread.
mercury.sex: Desire turns toward memory and repetition. Revisit what used to excite you together, and talk explicitly about preferences instead of assuming you know.

venus.power: Venus retrograde (when Venus seems to move backwards in the sky) comes every eighteen months for about six weeks. It asks you to reassess your image and values. Refine your style or brand rather than overhaul it.
venus.abundance: Avoid major purchases or cosmetic changes now. Review what you truly value and spend on, and renegotiate prices or rates that no longer reflect your worth.
venus.love: Exes and old patterns return for review. Ask what you want from love, heal what still aches, and hold off on new commitments until Venus goes direct (moves forward again).
venus.sex: Pleasure turns inward: rediscover what you enjoy alone and together. Slow down, reconnect with old turn ons, and rebuild sensual confidence.

mars.power: Mars retrograde (when Mars seems to move backwards in the sky) comes every two years for about ten weeks. It slows drive and stalls launches. Rework strategies, fix what is broken, and resist forcing outcomes.
mars.abundance: Hold back on aggressive investments and new ventures now. Use the time to repair finances, finish old projects, and plan your next push.
mars.love: Old conflicts resurface and anger turns inward. Process frustration privately first, then talk calmly about what needs to change.
mars.sex: Libido may dip or turn unusual. Explore slower, more mindful intimacy, and revisit desires you once put aside.

jupiter.power: Jupiter retrograde (when Jupiter seems to move backwards in the sky) lasts about four months each year. It turns growth inward. Review your goals, deepen your knowledge, and prepare for the next expansion.
jupiter.abundance: External luck slows, so focus on inner wealth: revise financial plans, consolidate gains, and cut wasteful habits.
jupiter.love: Reflect on what makes your relationships generous and joyful. Reconnect with shared values and dreams rather than chasing new excitement.
jupiter.sex: Pleasure becomes more reflective. Explore the meaning behind your desires, and deepen trust instead of seeking novelty.

saturn.power: Saturn retrograde (when Saturn seems to move backwards in the sky) lasts about four and a half months each year. It asks you to review structures and commitments. Repair foundations, and ask whether your ambitions still fit.
saturn.abundance: Revisit budgets, debts and long term plans now. Fix leaks, renegotiate terms, and build steady habits for the next phase.
saturn.love: Old relationship responsibilities and fears return for review. Strengthen commitments that work, and honestly release the ones that do not.
saturn.sex: Inhibitions surface for healing. Notice where fear or duty limits pleasure, and patiently rebuild trust and confidence with your partner.

sun.name: Sun
sun.gift: vitality, purpose and the courage to be seen

moon.name: Moon
moon.gift: moods, instincts and the need to feel safe

aries.mood: Everyone's pace quickens with the Moon in fiery Aries. People are impatient, direct and eager to start things, so tempers flare fast and cool just as fast.
aries.power: Act first and refine later: pitch the idea, send the email you keep drafting, or claim the lead on a stalled project. Keep it short and decisive, because today rewards initiative over polish.
aries.abundance: Start the income move you keep postponing, such as raising a rate or opening that savings account. Skip impulse buys made from restlessness by asking whether you will still want it in three days.
aries.love: Be the one who reaches out: name the plan, the time and the place instead of waiting to be chosen. Directness reads as attractive today, so tell them plainly what you like about them.
aries.sex: Desire runs hot and spontaneous, so let anticipation build early with a bold message or a confident touch. Ask what they want right now, and keep the pace playful rather than rushed.

taurus.mood: The Moon is exalted in Taurus (in the sign where it is strongest), so the mood settles and steadies. People want comfort, good food, familiar routines and proof before promises.
taurus.power: Build quiet authority by finishing what you started and showing tangible results. Bring numbers, samples or a working draft to any meeting, because today people trust what they can see and touch.
taurus.abundance: Review your budget, pay one bill early, or move a fixed amount into savings before you spend anything else. Price your work by the value it delivers, not by the hours it took.
taurus.love: Show love through the senses and through reliability: cook something, bring flowers, keep a small promise exactly. Slow, unhurried time together builds more trust today than grand declarations.
taurus.sex: Sensuality peaks with slowness: soft fabrics, warm scent, a long massage and no clock watching. Let touch lead before talk, and linger over what feels good instead of chasing a finish line.

gemini.mood: Minds speed up and attention scatters with the Moon in airy Gemini. Everyone is chatty, curious and juggling messages, so news travels fast and plans shift by the hour.
gemini.power: Network on purpose: send three short notes to people who could open a door, and share one clear idea where it will be read. Your influence today comes from being quick, witty and well informed.
gemini.abundance: Gather information before committing money: compare quotes, read the small print and ask for a second opinion. Small side deals, referrals and short gigs are favoured over big long-term bets.
gemini.love: Flirt through conversation: ask a surprising question, send a funny link, swap stories over coffee. Curiosity is the aphrodisiac today, so listen as much as you talk and keep the tone light.
gemini.sex: Words turn people on today: describe what you want in a message, or play a game of questions in bed. Variety and teasing beat routine, so try one small new thing together.

cancer.mood: The Moon is at home in Cancer, its own sign, so feelings run deep and protective. People crave family, nostalgia, safety and being looked after.
cancer.power: Lead by caring for your people: check in on your team, back someone who needs support, or make your workspace calmer. The loyalty you earn today turns into influence later.
cancer.abundance: Tend to home finances: stock the kitchen wisely, review insurance, or set money aside for a family goal. Trust your gut about a deal, but sleep on anything that feels emotionally pressured.
cancer.love: Nurture and let yourself be nurtured: cook together, call someone you miss, share an old memory. Vulnerability is magnetic today, so say what you need instead of hoping they will guess.
cancer.sex: Intimacy needs safety first: dim light, privacy, and cuddling that slowly becomes something more. Tell your partner what makes you feel held, and let emotional closeness set the pace of desire.

leo.mood: Hearts open and egos glow with the Moon in Leo. People want to be seen, praised and entertained, and both generosity and drama run high.
leo.power: Step into the spotlight: present your work, volunteer to speak, or post something you are proud of. Credit others generously as well, because shared applause makes your own presence larger.
leo.abundance: Invest in your visibility, such as a sharper portfolio, a better photo or a launch, but cap spending on pure show. Treat someone kindly within your budget, since generosity attracts goodwill.
leo.love: Romance wants warm attention and a little theatre: plan a date with flair, or give a sincere compliment in front of others. Make them feel like the star, and let yourself be adored back.
leo.sex: Erotic confidence runs high: dress up, perform a little, enjoy being watched and admired. Praise is fuel, so say out loud what you love about their body and their energy.

virgo.mood: With the Moon in Virgo the mood turns practical and careful. People notice details, fix what is broken, and feel calmer once the list is ticked off.
virgo.power: Win respect through competence: tidy a process, catch the error, deliver exactly what was asked. Offer one useful improvement to a decision maker, framed as a solution rather than a critique.
virgo.abundance: Audit subscriptions, chase unpaid invoices and reconcile your accounts. Small efficiencies compound, so close one leak and redirect that amount to savings or a skill that raises your rate.
virgo.love: Show love through acts of service: run an errand for them, remember a small detail, help with a chore. Catch the urge to nitpick and turn it into kindness instead.
virgo.sex: Attention to detail is sexy today: notice exactly what makes them respond and do more of it. Freshen the room, care for your own body, and ask one specific question about what they prefer.

libra.mood: The Moon is in Libra, a sign guided by Venus, and the social mood softens toward fairness and charm. People seek agreement, beauty and partnership, and avoid open conflict.
libra.power: Negotiate, mediate and build alliances, because today you gain more through partnership than solo effort. Propose a collaboration, or smooth a tense working relationship with a balanced, gracious offer.
libra.abundance: Money moves through relationships: settle a shared expense fairly, renegotiate terms, or pitch a joint venture. Spend on beauty only when it truly adds value to your life or your brand.
libra.love: Romance comes easily now: plan an elegant date, dress with care, and make room for real dialogue. Ask your partner where things feel unbalanced, and meet them halfway.
libra.sex: Seduction thrives on beauty and reciprocity: set the scene with care and take turns giving and receiving. Ask, offer and mirror, because mutual pleasure is the whole theme today.

scorpio.mood: The Moon is in its fall in Scorpio (a sign where it feels weak), so emotions go underground and grow stronger. People sense hidden motives, guard secrets and feel everything strongly.
scorpio.power: Work strategically and quietly: research the decision maker, read between the lines, and keep your cards close. Pour your focus into one deep task rather than many shallow ones.
scorpio.abundance: Look at debts, shared resources, taxes and investments with unflinching honesty. A frank talk about joint money can clear a long blockage, so ask the question you have been avoiding.
scorpio.love: Choose intimacy over small talk: share something real and ask for honesty in return. Trust deepens when you admit a fear, and jealousy shrinks when you name it calmly instead of acting it out.
scorpio.sex: Desire runs deep and magnetic: hold eye contact, build slow intensity, and voice a fantasy you usually keep private. Agree on boundaries first, then let yourself be fully present and unguarded.

sagittarius.mood: The Moon is in Sagittarius, a sign guided by Jupiter, so spirits lift and horizons widen. People feel restless, optimistic, opinionated and hungry for adventure or meaning.
sagittarius.power: Share your vision: teach, publish, pitch the big picture, or reach out to someone far outside your usual circle. Confidence is contagious today, but back every promise with one concrete next step.
sagittarius.abundance: Opportunities show up through travel, learning and distant or online contacts, so say yes to a class or a cold pitch. Set a spending cap before you go out, because optimism inflates the bill.
sagittarius.love: Plan a small adventure together, even a new café or a walk somewhere unfamiliar. Honesty and humour bond you today, so laugh, explore and talk about the dreams you share.
sagittarius.sex: Keep it playful, spontaneous and free: try a new setting, laugh in bed, treat pleasure as exploration. Ask a curious question about something they have always wanted to try.

capricorn.mood: The Moon is in its detriment in Capricorn (a sign where it works less easily), so feelings turn reserved and duty comes first. People are serious, goal driven and a little cool.
capricorn.power: Excellent for structure and ambition: set a quarterly goal, ask for a formal review, or own a hard decision in front of others. Speak plainly and let your track record do the talking.
capricorn.abundance: Make long-term money moves: automate savings, plan a pension contribution, or set a clear pricing policy. Think in years rather than days, and say no to the cheap shortcut.
capricorn.love: Show commitment through reliability: make a plan and keep it, talk about the future, arrive on time. Warmth may feel harder to reach today, so offer one small, sincere gesture anyway.
capricorn.sex: Slow-burn desire and playing with control can be thrilling when consent is clear: talk about who leads and who yields. Patience and steadily building tension pay off beautifully.

aquarius.mood: With the Moon in Aquarius the collective mood turns cool, inventive and group minded. People care about ideas, friends, causes and their freedom.
aquarius.power: Influence through community and fresh thinking: share an unusual idea, rally a group behind it, or use technology to scale your reach. Leaders who invite others in win today.
aquarius.abundance: Explore a new income stream, a digital tool or a group purchase. Your network can open an opportunity, so post clearly what you offer and ask who might need it.
aquarius.love: Friendship is the foundation now: give each other space and talk as equals. Surprise them with something unconventional, and respect their need for independence without taking it personally.
aquarius.sex: Openness and experiment are favoured: talk about fantasies without judgment and try one novelty together. Keep consent explicit and the mood friendly, curious and unhurried.

pisces.mood: The Moon in Pisces makes the mood dreamy, kind and open to the feelings of others. People are intuitive, creative, sensitive and easily overwhelmed.
pisces.power: Lead with empathy and imagination: tell a moving story, design something beautiful, or quietly support someone behind the scenes. Protect your energy with clear boundaries and real rest.
pisces.abundance: Trust your intuition about opportunities, but verify the facts before you sign or pay. Give a little to someone in need, and look honestly at any money leak you have been ignoring.
pisces.love: Romance turns tender and soulful: share music, art or a long, unhurried evening. Let yourself be seen softly, and listen for the feeling underneath their words.
pisces.sex: Merge and melt: soft light, music, water (a bath or shower together) and slow, dreamy touch. Fantasy and emotional closeness fuel desire, so share a daydream before you reach for each other.

new.name: New Moon
new.theme: The Sun and Moon meet in darkness, a fertile pause for choosing one clear intention and starting quietly.
new.power: Write down one goal for the coming month and take the smallest first step today, without announcing it yet.
new.abundance: Set a money intention with a number and a date, then open the account or file that will track it.
new.love: Decide what kind of love you want to grow and send one small signal toward it, like a message or an invitation.
new.sex: Reconnect with your own desire through solo pleasure or by journaling what you crave this month.

crescent.name: Waxing Crescent
crescent.theme: The waxing (growing) Moon shows its first sliver of light and momentum builds, so this is the phase to push past early doubt.
crescent.power: Gather allies and resources for your new aim by asking one well chosen person for advice or support.
crescent.abundance: Make the first small deposit, pitch or application, because steady early effort grows with the Moon.
crescent.love: Take gentle initiative with small, consistent gestures that let attraction build day by day.
crescent.sex: Build anticipation with teasing messages and plans rather than rushing straight to the main event.

first-quarter.name: First Quarter
first-quarter.theme: The Moon squares the Sun (stands at a right angle to it) in a turning point for action, so obstacles show you exactly where a firmer decision is needed.
first-quarter.power: Make the tough call you have been avoiding and commit, since hesitation costs more now than a mistake.
first-quarter.abundance: Meet the money obstacle head on: negotiate, cut one cost, or chase the overdue payment today.
first-quarter.love: Raise one friction point directly and kindly, because tension shared openly can deepen trust.
first-quarter.sex: Use any spark of friction as fuel, through playful competition or a frank talk about what you each want.

gibbous.name: Waxing Gibbous
gibbous.theme: Almost full, the Moon asks you to refine, edit and perfect what you started before it peaks.
gibbous.power: Polish the work, rehearse the pitch and ask for feedback so you are ready to shine at the Full Moon.
gibbous.abundance: Review the numbers, adjust the plan and tighten the details on any proposal or invoice.
gibbous.love: Fine-tune how you show up by listening closely, adjusting what is not working and planning something special.
gibbous.sex: Learn more about what pleases your partner by asking, watching their responses and gently adjusting.

full.name: Full Moon
full.theme: Opposite the Sun, the Moon reveals and peaks, bringing results, emotions and truths into full light.
full.power: Show your results, launch, or ask for recognition while visibility is at its peak.
full.abundance: Celebrate what has come in, collect what is owed, and notice clearly where money flows or leaks.
full.love: Feelings rise to the surface, so speak from the heart and celebrate the connection you have.
full.sex: Desire peaks, so embrace passion, celebrate your bodies and let yourself be fully seen.

disseminating.name: Disseminating
disseminating.theme: The waning (shrinking) Moon shares the harvest, a time to teach, give back and spread what you have learned.
disseminating.power: Mentor someone, share an insight publicly, or delegate a task you have already mastered.
disseminating.abundance: Give generously within your means, pay a favour forward, and share profit or credit fairly.
disseminating.love: Tell the people you love exactly what you are grateful for in them, out loud or in writing.
disseminating.sex: Focus on giving and appreciating pleasure rather than chasing new thrills.

last-quarter.name: Last Quarter
last-quarter.theme: The Moon squares the Sun again (stands at a right angle to it) in a turning point for awareness, prompting you to release what no longer fits.
last-quarter.power: Drop one commitment or role that drains you and reorder your priorities around what truly matters.
last-quarter.abundance: Cancel unused subscriptions, sell clutter and close any loose financial ends.
last-quarter.love: Let go of an old grudge or pattern, and have the honest conversation about what needs to change.
last-quarter.sex: Talk about routines or inhibitions that feel stale and agree on one you are ready to leave behind.

balsamic.name: Balsamic
balsamic.theme: The last dark sliver before the New Moon invites rest, reflection, healing and quiet preparation.
balsamic.power: Rest, review what this cycle taught you, and plan quietly instead of launching anything new.
balsamic.abundance: Look back over the past month's money and note intentions for the next cycle without acting yet.
balsamic.love: Offer forgiveness, rest together, and dream softly about the next chapter of your relationship.
balsamic.sex: Slow right down and choose tender, restful intimacy and gentle touch that reconnects you with your body.
