sun.tip: Send the pitch, ask for the promotion, or post your best work while the Sun rules the hour (each hour of the day is linked to one planet).

moon.good: home, family, intuition, the public, emotional connection, nurturing, routines
moon.tip: Call someone you love or tidy your space, then notice what your gut says about a pending decision.

mercury.good: writing, emails, negotiating, learning, sales, paperwork, short trips
mercury.tip: Draft the contract, send the invoice, or write the message you have been rehearsing in your head.

venus.good: romance, beauty, art, pleasure, socialising, harmony, gifts, money for enjoyment
venus.tip: Send a flirty message, book a date, or give yourself a small beauty or pleasure ritual.

mars.good: exercise, courage, competition, cutting ties, decisive action, physical passion
mars.tip: Work out, tackle the hardest task first, or make the bold move you have been holding back.

jupiter.good: growth, luck, generosity, teaching and learning, legal matters, big asks, travel plans
jupiter.tip: Ask for the raise, apply for the opportunity, or make one generous gesture without expecting a return.

saturn.good: discipline, long-term planning, boundaries, structure, endings, serious commitments
saturn.tip: Set a budget, sign a long-term agreement, or cleanly end something that is finished.

days.sun: Sunday is ruled by the Sun, a day for vitality and self-expression. Plan your week's power moves, buy one small thing that lifts your confidence, and spend warm, playful time with someone you love.
days.moon: Monday is ruled by the Moon, so feelings, home and routines matter most. Review household money, nurture close bonds, and save intimacy for cosy, emotionally connected moments in the evening.
days.mars: Tuesday belongs to Mars, planet of drive and desire. Tackle the hardest task, negotiate assertively, start a fitness habit, and let physical passion be bold and direct.
days.mercury: Wednesday is Mercury's day, ideal for messages, deals and learning. Send pitches and invoices, read contracts closely, and flirt through clever conversation or a playful text.
days.jupiter: Thursday is ruled by Jupiter, the great benefic (a planet believed to bring good luck) of growth and good fortune. Ask for the raise, apply for opportunities, be generous, and plan an expansive date or adventure together.
days.venus: Friday is Venus's day of love, pleasure and beauty. Put romance and sensuality first, treat yourself within budget, and handle money talks through charm and fair offers.
days.saturn: Saturday belongs to Saturn, planet of structure and time. Organise your finances, set long-term goals, clarify boundaries in love, and enjoy slow, patient intimacy built on trust.

power.title: Name your aim at sunrise
power.how: Stand in daylight for two minutes and say aloud the one result you want this week, in the present tense. Then write the single action that would prove you mean it, and do it before noon. Repeated daily, this trains your attention to behave like the person in charge.
power.best: Sun hour on a Sunday, or any day the Moon is in Leo or Aries

power.title: Keep a brag file
power.how: Keep a running document of wins, praise and numbers you have moved, and add one line every week even when it feels small. Before any review, pitch or negotiation, reread it slowly. You walk in with evidence, and the posture that comes with knowing your own record.
power.best: Sun hour, or the Moon in Capricorn

power.title: Ask for the meeting
power.how: Pick one person a level or two beyond you who could change your trajectory. Send a short, specific request for fifteen minutes, saying why them and what you will bring. One ask a week builds a network far faster than waiting to be noticed.
power.best: Mars or Mercury hour on a Tuesday, with a waxing (growing) Moon in Aries

power.title: Posture before the room
power.how: Before an important call or meeting, stand tall, drop your shoulders, slow your breathing and let your voice settle a little lower. Hold that for one minute while you picture the conversation going well. It guarantees nothing, but it changes how you enter, and people notice.
power.best: Mars hour, or the Moon in Leo

power.title: Ten-minute decision
power.how: Choose a decision you have been circling. Set a ten-minute timer and list the options, the worst realistic outcome of each, and what you would do if it happened. When the timer rings, choose and tell one person, so the choice becomes real.
power.best: Mars hour on a Tuesday, or the First Quarter Moon

power.title: The no list
power.how: Write down three commitments, meetings or habits that drain your energy or blur your authority. Decline or end one this week with a short, gracious line such as 'I can't take this on and do it well.' Saying no is what makes your yes worth something.
power.best: Saturn hour on a Saturday, or the Last Quarter Moon

power.title: The mentor's question
power.how: Ask someone you admire: 'What did you do at my stage that made the biggest difference?' Write the answer down and try one piece of it within a week. Then tell them what happened, which turns a single piece of advice into an ongoing relationship.
power.best: Jupiter hour on a Thursday, or the Moon in Sagittarius

power.title: Speak in the first five minutes
power.how: In your next meeting, make one clear contribution within the first five minutes, even if it is just a sharp question or a summary. Early voices shape the conversation and are remembered as leaders. Prepare that sentence in advance so it comes out steady.
power.best: Sun or Mars hour, with a waxing (growing) Moon in Aries or Leo

power.title: Quarterly crown
power.how: At the start of each season, write the one achievement that would make you proud in three months. Break it into twelve weekly steps and put them in your calendar. Review every Saturday, adjust without guilt, and keep going.
power.best: Saturn hour near a New Moon, ideally with the Moon in Capricorn

power.title: Credit someone in public
power.how: Publicly credit a colleague's specific contribution: in a meeting, in an email copied to their manager, or in a post. Name exactly what they did and the effect it had. Generous, precise recognition signals confidence and builds the kind of loyalty that follows a leader.
power.best: Sun or Jupiter hour on a Sunday or Thursday

abundance.title: Weekly money date
abundance.how: Once a week, sit down with a favourite drink and look at every account, bill and incoming payment for twenty minutes. Note one thing to celebrate and one leak to fix. Calm, regular attention turns money from a source of dread into something you steer.
abundance.best: Venus hour on a Friday, or Jupiter hour on a Thursday

abundance.title: Rate-raise script
abundance.how: Write three sentences for raising your price or asking for a raise: the value you deliver, the new number, and the date it starts. Practise aloud until your voice stays even on the number. Then say it or send it within the week.
abundance.best: Jupiter hour on a Thursday, with a waxing (growing) Moon in Taurus or Capricorn

abundance.title: Invoice sweep
abundance.how: Gather every unpaid invoice, refund, deposit or loan owed to you and list them with amounts and dates. Send a polite, firm reminder to each one the same day. Money you have already earned is the easiest abundance to claim, and chasing it builds self-respect.
abundance.best: Mercury hour on a Wednesday, or the Full Moon

abundance.title: Gratitude ledger
abundance.how: Each evening, write three things you received that day, from a payment to a free coffee to a useful tip, and note who gave each one. Thank at least one of them. Noticing the flow trains you to spot opportunity and strengthens the relationships that bring it.
abundance.best: Jupiter hour, or any day the Moon is in Taurus or Cancer

abundance.title: Leak hunt
abundance.how: Pull your last two months of statements and highlight every recurring charge. Cancel anything you have not used in a month and set up an automatic transfer of the saved amount into savings. Then add up the total you freed and enjoy the number.
abundance.best: Saturn hour on a Saturday, during a Last Quarter or Balsamic Moon (the last dark days before the New Moon)

abundance.title: One opportunity a day
abundance.how: Every morning, send one message that could create income: a pitch, a follow-up, an application or a referral request. Track them in a simple list with dates. Over a month, the number of asks, far more than luck, is what usually moves results.
abundance.best: Mercury or Jupiter hour, with the Moon waxing (growing)

abundance.title: Name a seed fund
abundance.how: Open a separate pot or account named for one specific goal and make a small first deposit. Add a little every week, even a symbolic amount. A named, visible fund keeps your intention concrete and your attention on growth instead of scarcity.
abundance.best: New Moon in Taurus or Capricorn, during a Venus or Jupiter hour

abundance.title: Invest in one skill
abundance.how: Choose one skill that would raise your earning power within a year, and book the course, buy the book or contact the mentor this week. Block two hours weekly to practise. Investing attention in yourself is the compounding you control most directly.
abundance.best: Jupiter hour on a Thursday, or the Moon in Sagittarius or Virgo

abundance.title: Generous circulation
abundance.how: Give something within your means this week: a donation, a bigger tip than usual, or a free hour of your expertise to someone just starting. Do it without expecting a return. Generosity keeps you in a mindset of enough and widens your circle naturally.
abundance.best: Jupiter hour on a Thursday, or the Disseminating Moon

abundance.title: Clear and sell
abundance.how: Walk through one room and pull out everything you have not used in a year. List what has value for sale and donate the rest the same week. Turning stagnant objects into cash and space creates a momentum you can actually feel.
abundance.best: Saturn hour, with a waning (shrinking) Moon in Virgo or Capricorn

love.title: Ask the deeper question
love.how: Over dinner or a walk, ask one question you have never asked, such as 'When did you feel most loved as a child?' Listen without fixing or interrupting, then share your own answer. Depth builds a bond faster than time alone ever will.
love.best: Venus hour on a Friday, or the Moon in Scorpio or Cancer

love.title: The six-second kiss
love.how: Make a habit of one lingering kiss or embrace each day, held for at least six seconds. It breaks autopilot and quietly says 'I choose you' in the middle of a busy routine. Anchor it to a fixed moment, such as hello or goodbye, so it sticks.
love.best: Venus or Moon hour, or any day the Moon is in Taurus

love.title: Handwritten love letter
love.how: Write a short letter by hand naming three specific things you love about someone and one memory you treasure with them. Leave it where they will find it on an ordinary day. Specific appreciation lands far deeper than general compliments, and it gets reread.
love.best: Venus hour on a Friday, with a waxing (growing) Moon in Libra or Pisces

love.title: Date yourself
love.how: Take yourself somewhere you love, alone: a gallery, a café, a long walk by water. Dress as you would for a date and notice how you treat yourself through the hours. People who enjoy their own company carry a warmth that draws others in.
love.best: Venus hour, or the Moon in Leo or Taurus

love.title: Repair conversation
love.how: After a fight, wait until you are both calm, then each say what you felt, what you needed, and one thing you will do differently. Use 'I' statements and end with a touch or a thank you. Repair, not perfection, is what keeps love durable.
love.best: Mercury or Venus hour, with the Moon in Libra or at the Last Quarter

love.title: Update your love map
love.how: Ask your partner about their current worries, hopes and small favourite things, as if you were interviewing them for the first time. Note a few answers and act on one within the week. Feeling known is one of the strongest glues in any relationship.
love.best: Moon or Mercury hour on a Monday, with the Moon in Gemini or Cancer

love.title: Say yes to the invitation
love.how: If you are single, accept the next social invitation you would normally decline, and talk to at least one new person there. Ask an open question and follow up with a message the next day. Love tends to arrive through doors you actually walk through.
love.best: Venus or Jupiter hour, with a waxing (growing) Moon in Libra or Sagittarius

love.title: Evening high and low
love.how: Create a ten-minute ritual each evening: phones away, and each of you shares the high point and low point of the day. Keep it going even on busy nights, when it matters most. Small rituals become the architecture of lasting intimacy.
love.best: Moon hour on a Monday, or any day the Moon is in Cancer

love.title: Swap love languages
love.how: Each of you writes down the two ways you most feel loved: words, touch, time, gifts or practical help. Swap lists, and for one week do one thing daily in their language rather than yours. At the end, compare how it felt on both sides.
love.best: Mercury hour on a Wednesday, or the Moon in Virgo or Libra

love.title: Mirror of desire
love.how: Write the qualities you want in a partner, then circle the ones you already live and underline the ones you still need to grow. Choose one underlined quality to practise this week. You tend to attract, and keep, more of what you embody yourself.
love.best: New Moon in Libra or Taurus, during a Venus hour

sex.title: Desire inventory
sex.how: Write a private list of what turns you on, what you are curious about, and what is off limits, without editing yourself. Share whatever parts feel safe with your partner and invite them to do the same. Clarity about your own wants is the foundation of erotic confidence.
sex.best: Mars or Venus hour, with the Moon in Scorpio

sex.title: Slow touch session
sex.how: Spend twenty minutes taking turns giving and receiving touch with no goal, the receiver guiding pressure and pace with simple words. Agree beforehand that nothing more is expected. It builds sensitivity and trust, and desire often grows stronger precisely because nothing is demanded.
sex.best: Venus hour on a Friday, or the Moon in Taurus

sex.title: Sensual self-care
sex.how: Take a long bath or shower with oil and music, paying attention to how your body feels rather than how it looks. Moisturise slowly and breathe into the sensations. Feeling at home in your own skin is the root of confident, relaxed desire.
sex.best: Venus or Moon hour, with the Moon in Taurus or Pisces

sex.title: Yes, no, maybe list
sex.how: Each of you marks a list of activities and ideas as yes, no or maybe, then compare answers kindly and without pressure. Start with the shared yeses and talk with curiosity about the maybes. It turns an awkward conversation into a playful, honest exploration.
sex.best: Mercury hour, with the Moon in Gemini or Aquarius

sex.title: Anticipation message
sex.how: Send a suggestive message in the morning describing something you are looking forward to later. Keep it tasteful and mindful of where they will read it. Anticipation builds desire all day and turns an ordinary evening into an event you both lean toward.
sex.best: Mars or Venus hour on a Tuesday or Friday, with the Moon waxing (growing)

sex.title: Move to feel alive
sex.how: Do something physical that makes you feel strong and awake: dance, lift, run or stretch until you sweat. Afterwards, notice the warmth and energy moving through your body. Physical vitality and erotic energy feed each other, so tend to both on purpose.
sex.best: Mars hour on a Tuesday, or the Moon in Aries or Leo

sex.title: Set the scene
sex.how: Prepare your space with intention: clean sheets, soft lighting, music you both like and a pleasant scent. Put phones in another room. A dedicated environment tells your nervous system it is safe to slow down and switch into pleasure.
sex.best: Venus hour on a Friday, with the Moon in Libra or Taurus

sex.title: Two minutes of eye contact
sex.how: Sit facing your partner and hold eye contact for two minutes without speaking, breathing slowly together. It may feel awkward or funny at first, so let yourselves laugh. The quality of presence it creates carries straight into touch and intimacy afterwards.
sex.best: Moon or Venus hour, with the Moon in Scorpio or Pisces

sex.title: Fantasy sharing
sex.how: Take turns sharing a fantasy, starting with something light, under a clear agreement that sharing is not the same as doing. Listen with curiosity, not judgment, and thank each other for the trust. Simply talking about desire can be deeply intimate and arousing.
sex.best: Mars or Venus hour near a Full Moon, or the Moon in Scorpio or Aquarius

sex.title: Afterglow talk
sex.how: After intimacy, spend a few minutes sharing what you loved and anything you would like more of or want to try. Keep it warm, specific and light on critique. This gentle feedback loop steadily improves chemistry and deepens trust over time.
sex.best: Moon or Venus hour, with the Moon in Cancer or Libra
